# Pull request

## What changed

Describe the behavior the pull request adds or fixes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit carries a `Signed-off-by` trailer that matches the author
      (`git commit -s`) and certifies the Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1.
- [ ] Tests cover the new behavior, including its failure modes.
- [ ] Documentation that the change makes stale is updated.
- [ ] `scripts/ci.sh` passes locally.
